text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Weekend-exclusive sweets buffet!
There's only one 'Chef's Whim Cake' left, so grab it while you can~!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Thank goodness, I made it in time...
I've been looking forward to this for so long...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
A sweet scent...
It feels like it's gently unraveling all my tension...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... I wonder
just what it tastes like...?

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Huh? The chef's special cake is already gone...?
I wonder who took it...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still in Love had the best day ever at the sweets buffet.
